'''Yeast''' was an ingredient in [[Ale/Legends|ale]]-brewing.<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> [[Slime yeast]] was a type of food found in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]<nowiki>'</nowiki>s galley,<ref name="Star Wars 1977 52">[[Star Wars (1977) 52|''Star Wars'' (1977) 52]]</ref> while [[yeast paste]] was a commodity at the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] prison.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Muur (food)|Muur]] was a yeast-based food that was a staple of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>
